summary: Iter146 — Task 1 (bot story anti-duplicate + quota 1/24h) and Task 2 (StoriesBar scrollBody padding) verified. 7/7 backend tests PASS. Task 1a: `_bot_create_story` correctly skips a second call for the SAME (bot, feud) when an active story already exists (count stays at 1). Task 1b: after 1 story creation on feud A, a second call with a different feud B within 24h is silently skipped (quota `recent >= 1` gate). Regression: GET /api/stories/feed returns 200 with valid groups structure for admin; GET /api/feuds still healthy; POST /api/auth/signup + /api/auth/anonymous still work. Task 2: /app/frontend/src/components/StoriesBar.tsx compiles cleanly (Metro bundled OK, no red screen, no runtime warnings tied to the change); the chevron collapse button retains testID='stories-bar-collapse-btn' at position top:2/right:6 as required; scrollBody now uses paddingLeft: spacing.md + paddingRight: 36 so the last circle no longer slides under the chevron on right-scroll. Visual verification is left to the user per the request note; layout is safe and non-breaking.

critical_code_review_comments: bot_engine.py::_bot_create_story — anti-duplicate check uses `expires_at: {$gt: now}` which correctly ignores already-expired records (matches the ~24h TTL semantics). The daily-quota check filters by `created_at >= now - 24h` on this bot only. Both checks run BEFORE the LLM caption call, so no wasted LLM budget on skipped writes — good.

Note (informational, not a bug): the anti-duplicate query is not indexed on {user_id, feud_id, expires_at}. At current scale (100 bots × few active stories) this is fine, but if the fleet grows an index on {user_id: 1, feud_id: 1} would keep this hot-path cheap.

StoriesBar.tsx::scrollBody — the paddingRight: 36 value is a reasonable buffer: chevron width 20 + right:6 = 26 outer edge, +10 hitSlop = 36. Matches exactly the touch-target reserved space so the last circle stops right before the collapse button. Left padding remains spacing.md so the first circle keeps its original inset.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bot story anti-dup + 1/24h quota fixes are locked in at /app/backend/bot_engine.py:874-889. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter146_bot_story_dedup.py for any regression involving stories creation by bots. Key mechanic: monkey-patching `be._generate_story_caption` avoids the LLM budget; motor client MUST be created inside the same event loop as asyncio.run (see `_wire_db` helper) — a module-scope motor fixture will break because asyncio.run creates a fresh loop per test. StoriesBar chevron/collapse button testID='stories-bar-collapse-btn' is stable and only the scrollBody padding changed for the visual overlap fix.
rca_of_issue: N/A — bugs already fixed; this iteration only validates the fixes. Historical over-production RCA per E1: previous quota was `recent >= 3` and no anti-duplicate guard, so a bot could publish ≤3 stories per 24h and multiple takes on the same feud → observed ~186 stories over 3 days. Post-fix theoretical cap: 100 bots × 1 story/24h = 100 stories/day worst-case, and never more than 1 per (bot, feud). Anti-duplicate + quota checks are cheap DB reads placed before the LLM call, so also reduce LLM spend.
